name: Kashi Touya
source:
Work: Pastry Chef
Hobby: Walking dogs

Touya is an incredibly sweet and mild-mannered man who's very passionate about his job. He's quite humble and popular with women, but he's disheartened that they only like his looks rather than his cakes, which lowers his self-confidence. He's very appreciative of people who enjoy his cakes.

He's described to be very clumsy for he tends to run into things accidentally.
